title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Wednesday, 23 September 2026
description: Today: the UN Security Council holds a high-level AI safety briefing with Sam Altman and Dario Amodei as Albanese pushes back on Trump's censorship claims over Australia's digital duty of care laws; a bushfire continues to burn at Teelah in the South Burnett; and a Coomera security guard remains in hospital after an alleged assault by a group of teens. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
